scope.summary: Operator-listed fixes. (a) storage::artifacts::resolve_workspace_root no longer falls back to the compile-time CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR; order is HANDSHAKE_WORKSPACE_ROOT -> nearest ancestor with .handshake/ -> nearest git checkout root -> hard error (disk-agnostic, CX-109B). (b) storage::artifacts::sha256_hex is the single crate helper; normalize_sha256_hex_ref / format_sha256_ref / sha256_refs_match handle the three spellings (bare, sha256:, sha256-, artifact://sha256/). Sweep of the ~40 private fn sha256_hex copies: DONE for api/loom.rs; REMAINING for the non-lane files (workflows.rs, flight_recorder/mod.rs, kernel/*, knowledge_*, memory/injection.rs, mex/supply_chain.rs, role_mailbox.rs, governance_pack.rs, capability_registry_workflow.rs, bundles/zip.rs, ai_ready_data/*, loom_ai/mod.rs, inspector_read/trace_projection.rs, swarm_orchestration/state_recovery.rs, user_manual/store.rs, storage/surreal/kernel_crdt_store.rs) and, AFTER the lanes land, the atelier files (exports.rs, intake.rs, moodboards.rs, sheet.rs, sourcing.rs, editable_surface_authority.rs) and the frontend copies. (c) storage::artifacts::write_file_artifact_streaming + StreamingFileArtifactSpec + remove_file_artifact; POST /atelier/media-assets raw-body ingest with HANDSHAKE_MEDIA_INGEST_MAX_BYTES (default 4 GiB) enforced while streaming; blob -> verify -> row with compensating remove on row failure / dedup. (d) Loom JSON+base64 import: explicit decoded-size cap + empty-payload rejection; documented as not a bulk-binary path.
